name: Futatsuguri Munetaka
source:
Tamayo's uncle who manages the shady side of the Futatsuguri family's business.
Munetaka handles Sarubotoke Island's red-light district and keeps the working girls in line. He's not exactly thrilled about Tamayo taking the reins as the family head and has a reputation for being a real hardass about everything.

"Deal with curses or divine retributions away from me, please...."
